obligations.description: Asynchronous reset and synchronous selected-bank flush
obligations.setup: Use fixed parameters159/2/2,eight banks and known binary inputs stable around rising edges. Establish pair/active state only through accepted enqueue and ready-gated head loads after asynchronous reset.
obligations.stimulus: Use fixed parameters159/2/2,eight banks and known binary inputs stable around rising edges. Establish pair/active state only through accepted enqueue and ready-gated head loads after asynchronous reset. Fill pending and active data in every bank, stall outputs, assert reset between edges, and inspect immediately after settling. Reinitialize distinct banks and flush each one while simultaneously attempting enqueue, head loading or retirement; also toggle flush between edges without a rising edge.
obligations.expected: Reset immediately zeros all state and outputs; a flush only clears its selected bank at its edge and wins all simultaneous operations there. Other banks retain or advance according to their own inputs.
obligations.sampling: 1ns after rising clk and asynchronous reset assertion; accepted values and enables use pre-edge state.
obligations.checker: An independent input-only abstract queue and lane-eligibility model predicts every native output. Separate actual/predicted wires feed four-state comparisons1ns after rising clk and asynchronous reset. No DUT output or hierarchy enters prediction; any mismatch reports UVM_ERROR, with finite stimulus and mandatory sample/reset counts.

anchors.2: Complete setup, actual stimulus, expected relation, sampling and independent failure check.

obligations.description: Queue capacity and native ready relationship
obligations.setup: Use fixed parameters159/2/2,eight banks and known binary inputs stable around rising edges. Establish pair/active state only through accepted enqueue and ready-gated head loads after asynchronous reset.
obligations.stimulus: Use fixed parameters159/2/2,eight banks and known binary inputs stable around rising edges. Establish pair/active state only through accepted enqueue and ready-gated head loads after asynchronous reset. Hold downstream blocked and send at least three pairs to each bank; inspect both ready outputs and perturb rejected inputs. Then release downstream while full and keep input valid, observing rejection on the first head-loading edge and acceptance only once pre-edge occupancy is below two. Exercise simultaneous load/enqueue from occupancy one.
